questions.question: B. Write the complete code (Client Side code, Bean code, and Bean associated code if any) for the following scenario. Scenario: The client side display should have 3 Text boxes (One for entering the Principal amount (P), another for entering the Number of Years (N) and another for entering the Rate of interest(R)) and a Submit button. On clicking the Submit button after the values are entered, the client side code should set everything right for the client right from getting the connection to the JMS Queue till the creation of the Sender. The message composed for transit should be of the form CSE 427 P-T-O Page 2 of 3 M(”P”+”,”+”N”+”,”+”R”). This Message should now be put into the Queue along with when the message was sent with the help of Sender. Now that the Bean code should somehow get the P, N, R values from this message M in the queue, should calculate the Compound interest and the time M gets processed and should store the record (sent, result, processed) in an ArrayList of suitable type for later retrieval. Here sent indicates when M was sent, result indicates the calculated compound interest result and processed indicates when M gets processed (3+7) ************************** CSE 427 Page 3 of 3
